sv.title: Alexander Isak slår till i Champions League
sv.summary: Alexander Isak, 27, är stekhet. Anfallsstjärnan gav Liverpool ledningen borta mot Club Brügge i Champions League.

en.title: Alexander Isak strikes in Champions League
en.summary: Alexander Isak, 27, is on fire. The striker gave Liverpool the lead away to Club Brügge in the Champions League.
